Product Details: Turtle Wax introduces the next level of car care with Turtle Wax ICE Spray Wax. It is a universal product which even cleans glass. This product is designed to work on all exterior surfaces with the shine and protection benefits of a convenient spray wax, with less time and effort. Turtle Wax ICE Spray Wax is perfect for all automotive paints, exterior plastic and rubber trim. On today's clear coat paint and factory coated wheels, Turtle Wax ICE Spray Wax produces a slick, mirror like shine and fills in light swirl marks. It also produces exceptional water beading, and contains UV protection to help prevent fading from harsh sun exposure. The streak free shine and protection chemistry is so impressive, the formula can be used on automotive glass to clean and provide water repellency like a glass treatment. Key ingredients provide anti-static properties to help keep a car finish cleaner longer, and lubricity agents to make application easy. The unique polymer chemistry combines synthetic polymers and reactive silane chemistry to provide superior bonding to paint and plastic trim. The formula is so durable it beads longer than ordinary wax, in laboratory consecutive wash tests. Turtle Wax ICE Spray Wax is the perfect complement to ICE liquid wax. Use Turtle Wax ICE Spray Wax to boost shine and protection in between regular wax and polish applications, or after a car wash. The product can be applied in direct sunlight or in shade, with minimum buffing. Use a micro-fiber towel to restore vehicle to a showroom like finish. Turtle Wax ICE Spray Wax is ideal for the regular care of both clear coat and conventional finishes.
